body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony presented its pocket-sized e-book 'Reader Pocket Edition' equipped with a 5-inch display at CES 2010, which carries up to 350 of your favorite books.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
